rationale: Brown checker selected (1,2) while an existing (5,5) finalist had lower image error. Feature seeding stayed local to the first pair and returned no retained seeds; six seconds of MILP recovery failed. Separate this solver issue from crop quality.

cases.rule: All eight review-required exports plus all five newly checked exports from the fixed 42-photo projective replay. No manual crop, material, phase, feature or count labels.

procedure: Recreate the unchanged source mask and observed-pixel coverage. Replay the current solver until its ordinary fine-grid finalists are ranked, capture those candidates, and stop before further routing or refinement. For each unique existing finalist count pair, call the unchanged feature-seed initializer on that finalist’s missing regions. Keep weighted/symmetric inputs explicitly ineligible under the current production policy. Record early solver returns instead of excluding them.
candidateLimits: At most three already generated finalist count pairs. No new counts outside the existing feature initializer, no changed image or feature acceptance, no manual best count.
metrics: Original-mask error and retained features before/after feature initialization
Initializer hypotheses, retained seeds and time for every candidate count base
Existing lower-error finalist versus complexity-preferred baseline
All positive control outcomes, including ineligible and early-return cases
decision: A useful alternate must meet the existing original-image and feature gates. Only then design a bounded scheduling change and test full solver/export results within the same ten-second budget. An initialization improvement is not a valid cutting-pair result.
qaDependency: Wait until projective-real-v1 current full suite succeeds; verify live controller before waiting. Do not run alongside its heavy tests.
